ارتقيتم (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَيْتُمْ (irtaqaytum) /ir.ta.qaj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# اُرْتُقِيتُمْ (urtuqītum) /ur.tu.qiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
